privileged_info_for_vlm: The experiment must be saved at /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/sst_task/stop_signal.psyexp. The conditions file must be at /home/ga/PsychoPyExperiments/sst_task/sst_conditions.csv and contain columns: direction, corrAns, stop_signal, and ssd. The sound asset is located at /home/ga/assets/beep.wav. The stop signal (sound) should only play when 'stop_signal' is 1; this is typically achieved in PsychoPy by setting the sound volume to '$stop_signal' or using a code snippet, though the primary check is the start time being '$ssd'.
